skill_name: In 100 words, describe the consequences of dropping out of high school
workflow: Dropping out of high school can have long lasting consequences, with economic and social consequences being some of the most significant. Economically, those who do not complete high school often face reduced earning potential, difficulty finding stable employment, and higher poverty rates, while those with at least a high school diploma are better able to pursue their career goals.
